author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review_findings: All four letters read clearly at native 48px in light and dark themes.
U and O bowls are tangent-continuous semicircles with a shared radius 6; letter gaps are uniformly 8 centerline units.
A crossbar sits at 75% height (reference ~66%) because the 1:4 integer leg slope only offers 50% or 75%; 75% keeps a readable counter.
omissions: Single-row layout changed to 2x2 (AU / TO): one row of four letters needs ~56 centerline units of width vs a 32-40 unit budget at MIC 8.
Reference's rounded A apex rendered as a short flat top with round joins.
